svg.title: 03 tool rotor bases
svg.desc: Editable native text and vector geometry, transparent background. No embedded raster artwork.

text.data-source-text: Add a rotor base to each tool
text.inkscape:label: Text: Add a rotor base to each tool
text.tspan: Add a rotor base to each tool

text.data-source-text: Each tool carries a compatible rotor base with its socket facing the arm's rotor head. Remove the base's own rotor head before use.
text.inkscape:label: Text: Each tool carries a compatible rotor base with its socket facing the a
text.tspan: Each tool carries a compatible rotor base with its socket facing the
arm's rotor head. Remove the base's own rotor head before use.

text.data-source-text: Keep the tool, rotor base and tool-side merge blocks rigidly connected as one tool body. Use one eligible rotor base per tool and leave its angle limits unlimited for the first pickup.
text.inkscape:label: Text: Keep the tool, rotor base and tool-side merge blocks rigidly connected
text.tspan: Keep the tool, rotor base and tool-side merge blocks rigidly connected
as one tool body. Use one eligible rotor base per tool and leave its
angle limits unlimited for the first pickup.
